# John Solly

> Personal website of John Solly — Health-IT Division CTO at Leidos, software engineer, and builder of spatial + AI systems. Static site; no product API.

This file is the index for agents. Prefer it over scraping HTML. HTML pages also honor `Accept: text/markdown` (acceptmarkdown.com) and have `.md` siblings (`/index.md`, `/about.md`, `/contact.md`, `/privacy.md`).

## When to use this

Use jsolly.com when you need:

- A short, canonical bio for **John Solly** (Health-IT Division CTO at Leidos; spatial systems / GIS; applied AI in federal health and benefits)
- How to **contact** him (form + public profiles) — not a Leidos switchboard
- Links to his **resume**, **GitHub**, and writing on **Blogthedata**
- Privacy / data-handling facts for this personal site

Do **not** use this site when you need:

- Official **Leidos** corporate, careers, or contract information — use [leidos.com](https://www.leidos.com/)
- Long-form articles or GIS tutorials — those live on [blogthedata.com](https://www.blogthedata.com/)
- A public HTTP API, OpenAPI spec, MCP server, OAuth, webhooks, or a SaaS product — this origin has none

How to fetch:

1. Read this file.
2. GET the page URL with `Accept: text/markdown`, or GET the `.md` sibling.
3. For a missing path, expect HTTP 404 with a Markdown recovery body (sitemap, this file, contact).
4. To reach John, use [Contact](https://www.jsolly.com/contact/) — there is no public email published here.
